# OmniViz (powered by Paarvix Core)

> Open-source, AI-native, self-hosted data visualisation, analytics and observability platform. An ultra-lightweight, self-hosted Grafana & Metabase alternative built with Angular 22 Zoneless Signals and NestJS Fastify. Connects Excel, Google Sheets, MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL on your own server. Runs smoothly on a 2GB RAM / 1 vCPU single container with zero cloud dependencies and no telemetry.

Status: Alpha (Production Preview). Data connections, columnar schema discovery, live preview, 10,000-node cluster observability simulation with LTTB downsampling, and bilingual AI Copilot (English & Tamil) are fully functional.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Source Ingestion**: Excel (.xlsx up to 50MB), Google Sheets, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL with read-only sandbox enforcement (30s timeout, 10k row limit).
- **Observability Engine**: High-frequency telemetry pipeline handling 10,000+ nodes with Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets (LTTB) downsampling from 10,000 points down to 500 render points in <15ms.
- **AI Copilot**: Provider-agnostic natural language query assistant supporting English and Tamil (பார்வை - Paarvai).
- **Indian Locale Support**: Native parsing for Indian currency (`₹1,25,000`), DD-MM-YYYY dates, and Tamil text/columns.
- **Privacy & Security**: 100% self-hosted, AES-256 envelope encryption, no phone-home telemetry.
